messages:
sylvia: opened a tiny docs hotfix PR to add the status page link and a short workaround after INC-1450. need quick eyes and a backport to stable.

sylvia: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/621

josh: looking now. where do you want the status link inserted?

sylvia: added it to /kb/outages.md and the incident notes. workaround: temporarily reduce prefix batching or disable KV-prefetch for affected workloads for ~6 hours.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #621  preview: https://deploy-preview-621--docs.redwoodinference.net

josh: quick nit  the Python example still uses the old sync helper. suggest switching to async client.text.generate to match v2.

sylvia: good catch  I pushed the async snippet update and a tiny migration note about client.text.* vs top-level helpers.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build failed for PR #621  error: 1 broken internal link (/guides/prefix-cache)  logs: https://deploy-logs.redwoodinference.net/621

josh: fixed the anchor and added a redirect alias in frontmatter. pushed commit.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded for PR #621  preview: https://deploy-preview-621--docs.redwoodinference.net

ops-bot: Incident INC-1450 page: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/INC-1450  include this link in the KB and mark resolved when ops confirms.

sylvia: included the status link and linked Known impact to INC-1450. added the one-line workaround and pointer to KV-cache debugging.

pat: I can handle the backport. target branch stable/v1.7-docs?

sylvia: yes, stable/v1.7-docs. title the cherry-pick "docs: backport INC-1450 hotfix" and link this thread.

josh: approving after final CI.

ci-bot: final build succeeded and checks green for PR #621.

sylvia: merging in 2 minutes to allow last-second holds.

josh: +1 merge.

sylvia: merged PR #621 into main.

pat: opened backport PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/622 (title: "docs: backport INC-1450 hotfix")  CI passed. tagging @support for KB rollout when ops confirms.

support: acknowledged, will post KB update after ops sign-off and then close the follow-up.

sylvia: saved PR and preview links to the incident notes. closing this thread  ping @sylvia to reopen if anything else pops up.
